description: Ministry of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine - Amend the Opium Board Constituted for Gampaha District, appointing two members
categorisation: This gazette notification specifically names individuals (Dr. M.A.A.K. Amarasinha and Dr. Sunil Shantha Wijethunga) who are being appointed to replace previous members of the District Opium Board. While it mentions the Minister's name and title, it does not include detailed descriptions of the ministerial portfolio responsibilities. The content focuses solely on personnel changes (appointments/replacements) to a government board, making it a People Gazette (Type 2).
